subject: Toucan
observations: User-approved engagement benchmark: the oversized two-tone beak and yellow face provide strong focal color, supported by substantial green leaves, blue feet and a brown branch.
Three separate leaves and two feet repeat color choices across recognizable regions; the broad body and beak remain accessible for ages 4+.
KEEP is based on composition and meaningful paintable variety, not an inflated count of background white, black ink, highlights or neighboring orange shades.
processed_gate_checks: Check dark-body/ink separation and preservation of the white chest; faint internal wing stroke need not become a numbered region.
scope: Source-image visual engagement review for ages 4+. Supersedes the previous generic source PASS for this exact image. Processed number placement, gameplay assets and video are not approved by this review.
